Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activity rows against human single-protein target CHEMBL260 (MAPK14). Join molecule_dictionary to activities to assays to target_dictionary, and join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter to target_type SINGLE PROTEIN, tax_id 9606, standard_type IC50, standard_relation '=', and pchembl_value not null. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Order by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID.
